note: state/pool-wake-poll/cursor: one integer, the largest wakes id bin/pool-wake-poll.sh has read for harness/build-queue (cursor.seed holds the progress of an unfinished seed). Written through a temp file and mv, read only by that lane. One file, no growth. A lost or junk cursor costs one seed run that launches nothing; the */10 fly crons cover a row that lands during it.

state/orc-monitor/missing.at: the epoch of the last 'hub script missing' line bin/orc-monitor.sh wrote, so the line comes at most once an hour. One file, no growth. Losing it costs one repeated log line.
